# Data Catalog

The West Coast Node ERDDAP data server hosts over 1,700 datasets.

On this catalog page, we’ve highlighted the most commonly used datasets by our users. To help you quickly find the dataset you need, use the interactive filter tool below — just answer a few short questions about the product type, sensor, region, and more.

To explore the full list of all available datasets, visit the [ERDDAP Server](https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/info/index.html?page=1&itemsPerPage=1000).

To explore the status of these datasets, visit the [Dataset Monitoring Dashboard](dataset_monitor.qmd).

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# ==========================================================
# LOAD DATA CATALOG YAML
# ==========================================================

catalog_path = Path("content/data_catalog.yml")

with catalog_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
    catalog = yaml.safe_load(file) or {}

datasets = catalog.get("datasets", []) or []


def safe(value):
    """Escape text for HTML."""
    return escape(
        str(value if value is not None else ""),
        quote=True
    )


def field(item, name):
    """Retrieve a field from the YAML dataset."""
    return str(item.get(name) or "").strip()


def safe_url(value):
    """Only allow HTTP and HTTPS links."""
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    parsed = urlparse(value)

    if parsed.scheme in {"http", "https"} and parsed.netloc:
        return value

    return ""


# ==========================================================
# GENERATE DATASET TABLE ROWS
# ==========================================================

rows = []

for i, item in enumerate(datasets):

    title = safe(field(item, "title"))
    product = safe(field(item, "product"))
    description = safe(field(item, "description"))
    dates = safe(field(item, "dates"))
    resolution = safe(field(item, "resolution"))
    composite = safe(field(item, "composite"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Filter attributes
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    attributes = {
        "product": field(item, "product"),
        "sensor": field(item, "sensor_type"),
        "region": field(item, "region"),
        "timeseries": field(item, "time_series_type"),
        "geo": field(item, "geostationary"),
        "blended": field(item, "blended"),
        "gapfilled": field(item, "gap_filled"),
        "derived": field(item, "derived_product"),
    }

    data_attrs = " ".join(
        f'data-{name}="{safe(value)}"'
        for name, value in attributes.items()
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # ERDDAP access links
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    access_links = []

    for link in item.get("access", []) or []:

        url = safe_url(link.get("url"))

        if url:
            access_links.append(
                (
                    safe(link.get("label") or "Open dataset"),
                    safe(url)
                )
            )

    if len(access_links) == 1:

        label, url = access_links[0]

        access_html = (
            f'<a class="cw-catalog-access-link" '
            f'href="{url}" '
            f'target="_blank" '
            f'rel="noopener noreferrer">'
            f'{label} ↗</a>'
        )

    elif access_links:

        options = "".join(
            f'<option value="{url}">{label}</option>'
            for label, url in access_links
        )

        access_html = (
            f'<label class="cw-catalog-sr-only" '
            f'for="access-{i}">Dataset access options</label>'
            f'<select id="access-{i}" '
            f'class="cw-catalog-access-dropdown" '
            f'aria-label="Access {title}">'
            f'<option value="">Choose access…</option>'
            f'{options}'
            f'</select>'
        )

    else:

        access_html = (
            '<span class="cw-catalog-unavailable">'
            'Not available'
            '</span>'
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Expandable description
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    details = []

    if description:
        details.append(
            f'<p>{description}</p>'
        )

    metadata = [
        ("Dates", dates),
        ("Resolution", resolution),
        ("Sensor", safe(field(item, "sensor_type"))),
        ("Region", safe(field(item, "region"))),
        ("Composite", composite),
    ]

    meta_html = "".join(
        f"<span><strong>{label}:</strong> {value}</span>"
        for label, value in metadata
        if value
    )

    if meta_html:
        details.append(
            '<div class="cw-catalog-metadata">'
            + meta_html
            + '</div>'
        )

    detail_html = (
        "".join(details)
        if details
        else "No description available."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Dataset row and detail row
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    rows.append(
        f"""
<tr class="cw-catalog-data-row" {data_attrs}>
<td>
<button
type="button"
class="cw-catalog-toggle"
aria-expanded="false"
aria-controls="catalog-detail-{i}"
>
{title}
<span aria-hidden="true" class="cw-catalog-chevron">⌄</span>
</button>
</td>
<td>
<span class="cw-catalog-product">{product}</span>
</td>
<td>
{access_html}
</td>
</tr>

<tr
class="cw-catalog-detail-row"
id="catalog-detail-{i}"
hidden
>
<td colspan="3">
<div class="cw-catalog-detail-content">
{detail_html}
</div>
</td>
</tr>
"""
    )

print("\n".join(rows))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  function initializeCatalog() {

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Find catalog elements
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    const table = document.getElementById("catalogTable");
    const search = document.getElementById("catalogSearch");
    const count = document.getElementById("catalogCount");
    const empty = document.getElementById("catalogEmpty");
    const reset = document.getElementById("catalogReset");

    if (!table || !search || !count || !empty || !reset) {
      console.warn("Data catalog elements not found.");
      return;
    }

    const rows = Array.from(
      table.querySelectorAll("tr.cw-catalog-data-row")
    );

    const selects = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll("#catalogFilters select")
    );

    const wrappers = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        "#catalogFilters .cw-catalog-filter"
      )
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Populate filter dropdowns from YAML-backed rows
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    selects.forEach(select => {

      const key = select.dataset.field;

      const values = [
        ...new Set(
          rows
            .map(row => (row.dataset[key] || "").trim())
            .filter(value => value && value !== "All")
        )
      ].sort((a, b) =>
        a.localeCompare(
          b,
          undefined,
          { sensitivity: "base" }
        )
      );

      values.forEach(value => {
        select.add(new Option(value, value));
      });

    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Apply filters and search
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    function updateTable() {

      const term = search.value
        .trim()
        .toLocaleLowerCase();

      let visibleCount = 0;

      rows.forEach(row => {

        const detail = row.nextElementSibling;

        const matchesFilters = selects.every(select => {

          const selected = select.value;

          // No selection or "All" means no restriction.
          if (selected === "" || selected === "All") {
            return true;
          }

          const value = (
            row.dataset[select.dataset.field] || ""
          ).trim();

          return value === selected;

        });

        const searchableText = [
          row.cells[0]?.textContent || "",
          row.dataset.product || "",
          detail?.textContent || ""
        ]
          .join(" ")
          .toLocaleLowerCase();

        const visible =
          matchesFilters &&
          (!term || searchableText.includes(term));

        row.hidden = !visible;

        if (!visible && detail) {

          detail.hidden = true;

          const toggle = row.querySelector(
            ".cw-catalog-toggle"
          );

          if (toggle) {
            toggle.setAttribute(
              "aria-expanded",
              "false"
            );
          }

        }

        if (visible) {
          visibleCount++;
        }

      });

      count.textContent =
        `${visibleCount} of ${rows.length} datasets`;

      empty.hidden = visibleCount !== 0;

    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Progressive filter visibility
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    function updateSteps(changedIndex = -1) {

      // If the user returns a filter to "-- Select --",
      // clear all subsequent filters.

      if (
        changedIndex >= 0 &&
        selects[changedIndex].value === ""
      ) {

        for (
          let i = changedIndex + 1;
          i < selects.length;
          i++
        ) {
          selects[i].value = "";
        }

      }

      // A filter becomes visible once the previous
      // filter has a selection, including "All".

      wrappers.forEach((wrapper, index) => {

        if (index === 0) {
          wrapper.hidden = false;
          return;
        }

        wrapper.hidden =
          selects[index - 1].value === "";

      });

    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Filter events
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    selects.forEach((select, index) => {

      select.addEventListener("change", () => {

        updateSteps(index);
        updateTable();

      });

    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Search
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    search.addEventListener(
      "input",
      updateTable
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Reset
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    reset.addEventListener("click", () => {

      selects.forEach(select => {
        select.value = "";
      });

      search.value = "";

      // Collapse any expanded dataset descriptions.

      rows.forEach(row => {

        const detail = row.nextElementSibling;
        const toggle = row.querySelector(
          ".cw-catalog-toggle"
        );

        if (detail) {
          detail.hidden = true;
        }

        if (toggle) {
          toggle.setAttribute(
            "aria-expanded",
            "false"
          );
        }

      });

      updateSteps();
      updateTable();

    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Expand and collapse dataset descriptions
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    rows.forEach(row => {

      const toggle = row.querySelector(
        ".cw-catalog-toggle"
      );

      const detail = row.nextElementSibling;

      if (!toggle || !detail) {
        return;
      }

      toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {

        const expanding = detail.hidden;

        detail.hidden = !expanding;

        toggle.setAttribute(
          "aria-expanded",
          String(expanding)
        );

      });

    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // ERDDAP access dropdowns
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    document.querySelectorAll(
      ".cw-catalog-access-dropdown"
    ).forEach(select => {

      select.addEventListener("change", () => {

        const url = select.value;

        if (url) {

          window.open(
            url,
            "_blank",
            "noopener,noreferrer"
          );

          select.selectedIndex = 0;

        }

      });

    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------
    // Initialize
    // ------------------------------------------------------

    updateSteps();
    updateTable();

  }

  // Run after HTML is available.

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {

    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      initializeCatalog
    );

  } else {

    initializeCatalog();

  }

})();
</script>
```
